2026-10-10: fixes for the third independent S7 review (docs/verification/phrf-cmp-s7-independent-review3-20261010.md), commit c160d6e3 on work/phrf-s7-reconcile, not pushed.

H1: a fatal throwable now leaves accounting.open (the final checkpoint still runs), so the resume refuses. Test: review3 H1, where the feed throws OutOfMemoryError after a 37 s GLMsingle attempt.
H2: a raise now names the output by the SHA-256 of its stamp.json. Test: review3 H2, accepted for output A and refused for B.
M1: a recovery already recorded for the uncertain run id is not charged again. Test: review3 M1, cost stays 100 with one record.
M2: a terminal Failed must have exactly maxRetries+1 attempts. Test: review3 M2.
L1: InvocationsExhausted refusal. L2: AccountingRecoveryInvalid refusal; marker and cost are kept. L3: PilotPlan.MaxRetries=100 and Long arithmetic in the verifier.
Hardening: historical authorization records in cost.json are validated.
The 240 core-hour cap remains the single constant OwnerCeilingRaise.MaxRaisedCoreHours, pending the owner's decision.

Reverting all fixes together fails all 7 review3 tests; files restored and verified by SHA-256.
Gates: JVM 514 total (504 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed); JS 246 passed; scalafimCompileAll exit 0 with 0 warnings. Synthetic only; a fourth review is pending.
